purpose: Make the source review operational as an isolated physical-store conversion contract. Missing geometry/material/context must remain missing;do not quietly turn a building footprint or annual modeled surplus into an ancient grain budget.
implementation: New standalone module with explicit named/unit-bearing physical-store records. Distinguish gross footprint from cereal-allocated usable area,effective fill depth,stored material state and matching bulk density,net-edible yield and edible energy density. Accept only a single explicitly allocated commodity per conversion;do not assign an entire mixed store by default. Record physical store identity,function/location/phase,ownership/access and evidence provenance separately from arithmetic. Do not connect to existing food producers or atlas.
arithmetic: Our bookkeeping,not Salido's authored law:bulk envelope V=A_usable*h_effective;stored mass M=V*rho_of_that_stored_state;net-edible equivalent E=M*eta_edible*e_edible. No defaults for h,rho,eta,e or structural support. Keep geometric energy separate from operational capacity;known structural support may constrain/reject a proposed fill,but unknown support/ventilation/duration/access/phase cannot establish usable historical capacity. Already-net-edible input must not receive another seed/processing deduction. Explicit reference flow can convert energy to days only with matching commodity/pool/location/phase and positive flow;zero/unknown flow yields undefined days,not a chosen0orInfinity.
evidence_status: Quantitative values must retain source/locator and observation,author_estimate,analogy,scenario or unknown labels. Arithmetic consistency must never assert empirical qualification. Outputs keep scenario/unknown inputs and context gaps visible. No source-number extraction from Salido's examples or cited Gentry/Manning tables;all new numeric examples are clearly manufactured and labeled scenario.
verification: Meaningful manufactured controls for unit-consistent volume/mass/energy,missing height/density,material/state mismatch,gross/mixed-space misuse,known structural-load exceedance,unknown operational constraints,already-net pool deductions,zero/mismatched flow and invalid quantities. Independently recompute manufactured arithmetic with Decimal. Read-only application of the contract to the six existing baseline store-class budgets may label their model-defined references and missing empirical fields;do not rerun stocks or change capacities.
deliverable: Small tested module/schema,manufactured validation receipt and source-to-model interface report. Existing rural/commercial/town budgets remain explicit scenarios. No ancient coefficient,model food case,quota/capacity sweep,site measurement row,new fit,demography/staff/atlas/default change or climate work. Reserved pools remain unopened.
